title: Nitrification regulates the responses of soil nitrous oxide emissions to nitrogen addition in China: a meta-analysis from a gene perspective
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2367-2378
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00057B, Paper
Zetao Dai, Yanglong Zhang, Yujie Li, Tao Xiang, Feifei Wang, Jiarui Peng, Shengchang Yang, Wenzhi Cao
China is a global hotspot of nitrogen (N) emissions and N deposition, which has implications for the N dynamics of ecosystems and stimulates the production of nitrous oxide (N2O).
